finding: Post-balance latency = slowest branch = root + ceil(L_max/seg) trunk stages + tap + local-tree levels (+ pads to it). With the ck pin on the S face / SW corner, L_max is 300-405 um and the floor in these trials is ~340 (vmr) .. ~420 (prog) TT. 250 TT needs the clock to ENTER near the core centre (12.7 slice: island + M9->M5 stack + interior ck pin), halving L_max to <=~200 um (2 trunk stages), and taps <=~300 sinks (2 local levels).
